# netskope_dns_profile_v2 (Data Source)

DNSProfileV2 DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "netskope_dns_profile_v2" "my_dnsprofilev2" {
  profile_id = "...my_profile_id..."
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `profile_id` (String) DNS profile UUID

### Read-Only

- `custom_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--custom_config))
- `description` (String) Profile description
- `domain_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--domain_config))
- `inheritance_groups` (List of String) Inheritance group names (max 1)
- `log_traffic` (String) Traffic logging level
- `name` (String) Profile name
- `tunnel_config` (Attributes) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--tunnel_config))
